name: 20659 · Mechanicsvlle, MD
findings: ZIP 20659 (Mechanicsvlle) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20659 (Mechanicsvlle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 20659 (Mechanicsvlle) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
